exposure: Region (Africa, Eurasia, Middle-East, and South Asia)
outcome: Physician awareness of VTE risk management guidelines
cohort: 4010 pregnant women attending prenatal care/obstetric centers across 18 countries in Africa, Eurasia, Middle-East, and South Asia
finding: More than 50% of women during pregnancy and postpartum were at risk of VTE, and >90% received prophylaxis as per the guidelines.
mod_finding: Women in Eurasia and South Asia undergoing pregnancy and postpartum care received both pharmacological and mechanical VTE prophylaxis more often than women in Africa and the Middle East, who primarily received pharmacological prophylaxis.
